title: Pure Ancient Gear
summary: Ancient Gear cards with generic staples. Led by the 2024–25 Legacy of Destruction and Maze of the Master wave, this EARTH Machine Fusion deck puts an Ancient Gear Golem on the board so Ancient Gear Fusion can send materials straight from the Deck for Chaos Ancient Gear Giant.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ancient Gear Wyvern searches any Ancient Gear card when Normal or Special Summoned (locking you out of Setting cards for the rest of the turn).
Ancient Gear Advance searches any Ancient Gear Spell/Trap on activation, and tributes a monster to draw a card and let you Normal Summon Level 5+ Ancient Gear monsters without Tributing that turn.

Ancient Gear Statue Special Summons itself from the hand while the opponent controls more monsters, then tributes itself to Special Summon Ancient Gear Golem or a monster that mentions it (such as Ancient Gear Dark Golem) from the hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

summary.title: Opening: Ancient Gear Advance or Statue
steps: Activate Ancient Gear Advance to search Ancient Gear Catapult (or Geartown), or Special Summon Ancient Gear Statue going second.
Use Catapult on Geartown (or tribute Statue) to Special Summon Ancient Gear Dark Golem directly from the Deck.
Dark Golem searches Ancient Gear Fusion and Ancient Gear Commander (or Ancient Gear Duel), then discards 1 card.

Because Dark Golem's name becomes Ancient Gear Golem on the field, activate Ancient Gear Fusion using Dark Golem on the field and three more Ancient Gear monsters straight from the Deck to Fusion Summon Chaos Ancient Gear Giant.

summary.title: Golem Engine & Extra Normal Summons
summary.text: Ancient Gear Dark Golem is treated as Ancient Gear Golem on the field or in the GY, satisfying every card that requires the original Level 8 without its Cannot be Special Summoned clause. Ancient Gear Commander sends an Ancient Gear Golem from your hand, Deck or field to the GY for an immediate extra Ancient Gear Normal Summon, then banishes itself from the GY to place an Ancient Gear Continuous Trap face-up from your hand or GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Chaos Ancient Gear Giant (4500 ATK) is unaffected by Spell/Trap effects, prevents the opponent from activating monster effects during the Battle Phase, and attacks every monster the opponent controls with piercing damage.

Ancient Gear Dragon can be Normal Summoned without Tributing on an empty field or alongside EARTH Machines, and sends a Machine from your hand/field or an Ancient Gear Golem from your Deck to the GY to negate a Spell/Trap effect.

Ancient Gear Duel makes all Ancient Gear Golems and monsters mentioning it unaffected by the opponent's activated monster effects, and Fusion Summons on the opponent's turn by banishing materials from your field or GY (including Golem) for Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem or Megaton Golem.
Ancient Gear Ballista (Link-2) searches Geartown or an Ancient Gear monster, then pops Geartown to reduce an opposing monster's ATK/DEF to 0 while Geartown floats into another Ancient Gear.
